# Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for repository safety, validation, and review
rules. For security reviews, use the workflow in
[`mcp-security-review/SKILL.md`](../.agents/skills/mcp-security-review/SKILL.md).

`main` is the secure baseline. The `demo/*` branches deliberately fail one
check and must never be merged. Use only fictional test data and authorized
local test environments.
